name: Six Senses Shaharut
positioning: Cliffside desert resort and spa in Israel's Negev Desert, above the Arava Valley
best_for: Couples wanting a suite or villa with a private pool and desert panoramas
Active travelers keen on archaeological sites, natural wonders and outdoor sports

facts.text: Six Senses Shaharut nestles into a dramatic cliff in the Negev Desert.
Suites offer a large outdoor space plus desert, valley and mountain views.
A GEM (Guest Experience Maker) is on hand to arrange activities.
Experiences range from exploring ancient archaeological sites and natural wonders to outdoor sports.
The Arava Valley offers historic landmarks and a setting for extreme sports.
The spa offers locally inspired treatments and integrated wellness therapies.
Food waste is composted, water is bottled on site and there is zero discharge of liquids into the environment.
Guests can visit the Earth Lab to learn about the resort's sustainability efforts.
The Nomadic Dinner is an intimate dinner for two, topped off with dessert in the desert.

highlights.text: The resort nestles into a dramatic cliff in the Negev Desert.
Suites and villas have uninterrupted desert panoramas and a private swimming pool.
Six Senses Shaharut was the first hotel in Israel to achieve LEED Certification.
The Nomadic Dinner is an intimate dinner for two, topped off with dessert in the desert.

considerations.text: The resort welcomes guests and children 10 years and older.
Guests reach the resort by a transfer through the desert landscape.
WhataHotel notes the remote desert location requires planned transportation.
